purpose: Feature-by-feature comparison of Dahal Jeet (single-hand variant) against Mendikot, the closest documented game. The count quoted in the paper is computed from this file, not asserted.
dahal_jeet_source: 01-rulebooks/dahal-jeet.md and the rule specification in the paper, implemented and tested in 05-engine/dahaljeet/
note: Feature granularity is a judgement of ours: splitting or merging rows changes the denominator. The table is published so a reader can apply their own granularity.
